chunks: Ali, from his father, from Hammad, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Friday [prayer], so he (peace be upon him) said: 'It is obligatory upon the one who is within two farsakhs of it. So when one exceeds that distance, there is nothing upon him [obligatory].'
ai.seo_question: What is the maximum distance for the Friday prayer to be obligatory?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi defines the radius of obligation for Salat al-Jumu'ah as two farsakhs (approx. 6 miles), reflecting the practical realities of travel in early Islamic Medina. It highlights the Shia juristic principle of 'rukhas' (dispensations) for those beyond this distance, distinguishing their status from those within the city limits who are required to attend the congregational prayer.
